query: SELECT rs.guild_id,rs.id FROM recording_sessions rs JOIN guild_recording_policy p ON p.guild_id=rs.guild_id WHERE p.retention_days IS NOT NULL AND rs.state='finalized' AND rs.ended_at < now() - (p.retention_days * interval '1 day') AND rs.deletion_requested_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM kept_recordings k WHERE k.recording_session_id=rs.id) ORDER BY rs.ended_at,rs.id LIMIT 25
